status: Pre-registered supplementary analysis, frozen before Run174 test evaluation or inspection of test scores.
purpose: Complete the frozen Run174 reporting of sequence-level metrics, re-detection, compute and outlier influence without changing training, checkpoint selection, inference, or the continuation rule.
amendment_note: The Run174 protocol already required outlier influence and re-detection reporting. Code review found that the runner retained per-sequence propagation events but did not aggregate those items or compute leave-one-sequence-out influence. This separately frozen summarizer fills that reporting gap. At freeze time the process was training the single_regional control; no validation/test efficacy scores had been inspected.

inputs.scope: Use only completed full-propagation results for the frozen test sequences seq16-seq23. Do not infer or fill missing values.

analysis.unit: sequence; each sequence has equal weight for sequence-level means and paired contrasts
analysis.uncertainty: 10,000 sequence bootstrap resamples using seed 20261107; paired two-sided Wilcoxon tests over sequences with Holm correction across the three frozen contrasts.
analysis.outlier_sensitivity: For each frozen contrast, report the full-cohort mean and every leave-one-sequence-out mean, range, sign retention, and maximum absolute change from the full-cohort mean. No sequence may be removed from the primary result.
analysis.redetection: Use the already-saved per-sequence propagation event records. Report total returns, detected and censored/undetected returns, plus median and mean delay among detected returns. Delays are sampled manifest frames; do not convert to seconds or treat censored returns as detected.
analysis.compute: Report per-sequence elapsed propagation time and FPS, total elapsed propagation time, aggregate FPS, and protocol-stated added reader parameters. Timing covers the recorded propagation loop and is not a full deployment benchmark.
analysis.false_alarms: Report total false masks over GT-empty frames, the pooled rate, the macro mean of per-sequence rates, denominators, and per-sequence rates.
analysis.missingness: Report sequence denominators and missing metric sequences explicitly. Never replace undefined scores with zero or silently drop sequences.
analysis.human_readable_table: Include one row per sequence and arm with present Dice, boundary F, false-alarm count and GT-empty denominator, re-detection events and delay, and FPS. The JSON also retains per-sequence IoU and other metrics.

decision_rule: The continuation decision remains exactly the one in iterative_memory_pilot_v1.json. This supplementary analysis adds no tuning, new success threshold, or post-hoc sequence exclusion.
